groups.name: agent
groups.description: Agents, who may use each, and the jobs they run.

groups.name: changeset
groups.description: Change sets, their revisions, and the component values they propose.

groups.name: component
groups.description: The component registry, where published Terraform modules, Helm charts and manifests live.

groups.name: env
groups.description: Deployment environments and the components in them.

groups.name: integration
groups.description: Integrations your organization connects, such as the GitHub App.

groups.name: run
groups.description: Runs of change sets and drift checks, plan through apply.

groups.name: serviceaccount
groups.description: Service accounts, and the issuers they accept tokens from.

groups.name: source
groups.description: Sources, the upstream locations components come from and the grants that reach them.

groups.name: state
groups.description: Hosted Terraform state and its versions.

scopes.name: agent:enroll
scopes.description: Enroll an agent, once, from where it runs. Held only by a single-use enrollment key.

scopes.name: agent:exec
scopes.description: Agent runtime work: claim, start, renew, append the log of, fetch the artifact of, upload the plan diff and plan file of, fetch the plan file of, check the plan of, and finish jobs.

scopes.name: agent:heartbeat
scopes.description: Send an agent's heartbeat: its version, where it runs, what it can deploy, the credentials it found, and its issuer's current keys.

scopes.name: agent:read
scopes.description: Read agents, who may use them, and their jobs.

scopes.name: agent:write
scopes.description: Create, update and delete agents; issue enrollment keys; grant use; cancel jobs.

scopes.name: apikey:read
scopes.description: Read your own API keys.

scopes.name: apikey:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and revoke your own API keys.

scopes.name: changeset:read
scopes.description: Read change sets, their revisions and diffs, and the values they propose.

scopes.name: changeset:write
scopes.description: Create, edit, and discard change sets.

scopes.name: component:publish
scopes.description: Publish versions and set tags. Adds to the registry and removes nothing from it, which is what a CI publish key holds.

scopes.name: component:read
scopes.description: Read components, their versions and tags, and the contract and findings each version carries.

scopes.name: component:write
scopes.description: Edit a component's metadata, deprecate or delete components, set a version's status, and delete floating tags, in addition to everything a publisher can do.

scopes.name: credential:read
scopes.description: Read credentials.

scopes.name: credential:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete credentials.

scopes.name: env:read
scopes.description: Read environments and their components.

scopes.name: env:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete environments.

scopes.name: integration:read
scopes.description: Read integrations, their status and what they connect to.

scopes.name: integration:write
scopes.description: Connect, install and remove integrations.

scopes.name: organization:read
scopes.description: Read organizations, their name, slug, status and logo.

scopes.name: organization:write
scopes.description: Update an organization's settings, and register, suspend, reactivate and delete organizations.

scopes.name: project:read
scopes.description: Read projects.

scopes.name: project:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete projects.

scopes.name: run:read
scopes.description: Read runs, their plans, applies and approvals.

scopes.name: run:write
scopes.description: Start, approve, apply, accept and cancel runs.

scopes.name: serviceaccount:read
scopes.description: Read service accounts and issuers.

scopes.name: serviceaccount:write
scopes.description: Register issuers, change their keys, and delete them.

scopes.name: source:read
scopes.description: Read sources, browse what they offer and discover versions.

scopes.name: source:write
scopes.description: Create, update and delete sources.

scopes.name: state:read
scopes.description: Read hosted Terraform state, its outputs and its versions. Enforced by admiral-state.

scopes.name: state:write
scopes.description: Lock, write and force-unlock hosted Terraform state. Whether you may is decided per environment, not by holding this. Enforced by admiral-state.

scopes.name: user:read
scopes.description: Read user profiles and invitations.

scopes.name: user:write
scopes.description: Invite users and revoke invitations; update profiles, change roles, revoke authentication factors, and suspend, reactivate and delete users.
